## Send us a message

Fill out the form below and Jeff Bumgarner, Director, will follow up with you.

```{=html}
<!--
  Contact form. FORM_ENDPOINT is blank until a form service is set up
  (e.g., Formspree, as ALERRT uses). While blank, submitting opens the
  visitor's email app with the message pre-filled, addressed to CONTACT_EMAIL.
-->
<form class="contact-form" id="contact-form" method="POST" data-endpoint="" data-email="jbbumgarner@txstate.edu">
  <div class="form-row">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="cf-name">Name</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-name" name="name" placeholder="Your name" required>
    </div>
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="cf-org">Organization</label>
      <input type="text" id="cf-org" name="organization" placeholder="Agency or institution">
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="form-row">
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="cf-email">Email</label>
      <input type="email" id="cf-email" name="email" placeholder="you@example.org" required>
    </div>
    <div class="form-group">
      <label for="cf-type">I am a...</label>
      <select id="cf-type" name="inquiry_type">
        <option value="">Select one</option>
        <option>Agency / Organization</option>
        <option>Researcher / Academic</option>
        <option>Journalist / Media</option>
        <option>Other</option>
      </select>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="form-group">
    <label for="cf-message">Message</label>
    <textarea id="cf-message" name="message" rows="5" placeholder="Tell us about your interest in working with TCJC..." required></textarea>
  </div>
  <button type="submit" class="form-submit">Send Message</button>
  <p class="form-status" role="status" hidden></p>
</form>

<script>
(function () {
  const form = document.getElementById('contact-form');
  const status = form.querySelector('.form-status');
  form.addEventListener('submit', async (e) => {
    e.preventDefault();
    const f = new FormData(form);
    const endpoint = form.dataset.endpoint;
    if (endpoint) {
      // Form service configured: send it there
      try {
        const r = await fetch(endpoint, { method: 'POST', body: f, headers: { Accept: 'application/json' } });
        status.textContent = r.ok ? 'Thanks! Your message was sent, and we\'ll be in touch soon.' : 'Something went wrong. Please email us directly.';
      } catch (err) { status.textContent = 'Something went wrong. Please email us directly.'; }
      status.hidden = false;
      if (status.textContent.startsWith('Thanks')) form.reset();
    } else {
      // No form service yet: open the visitor's email app with the message filled in
      const subject = `TCJC inquiry${f.get('inquiry_type') ? ' (' + f.get('inquiry_type') + ')' : ''}`;
      const body = `${f.get('message')}\n\n${f.get('name')}${f.get('organization') ? ', ' + f.get('organization') : ''}\n${f.get('email')}`;
      window.location.href = `mailto:${form.dataset.email}?subject=${encodeURIComponent(subject)}&body=${encodeURIComponent(body)}`;
    }
  });
})();
</script>
```

:::
